entity2.id1.entry3.subtitle: Muddada tijaabada ugu badan ee 1 bilood ah.Inta lagu jiro wakhtigan ogeysiisku waa 1 toddobaad.Muddada tijaabada ka dib, waqtiyada ogeysiiska sharciga ah ayaa khuseeya.
entity2.id1.entry4.title: Qandaraasyada muddada go'an
entity2.id1.entry4.subtitle: Qandaraasyada waqti go'an waa in si macquul ah loo caddeeyaa (tusaale, shaqada mashruuca, shaqada xilliyeed).Waa suurtogal ugu badnaan 4 sano, ka dibna si toos ah u waaraya.

entity2.id2.entry1.subtitle: Wakhti buuxa: Caadiyan 38.5 saacadood/toddobaadkii.Waqti-dhiman: Saacado yar, fasax saamile iyo xaq u lahaanshaha mushaharka.
entity2.id2.entry2.title: Tababarka shaqada
entity2.id2.entry2.subtitle: Tababarayaashu waxay leeyihiin xuquuq gaar ah: saacadaha shaqada oo xadidan, xaq u yeelashada dugsi xirfadeed, gunno tababar shaqo bedelkii mushaharka.
entity2.id2.entry3.title: Shaqaalaysiinta xad dhaafka ah
entity2.id2.entry3.subtitle: Ilaa €485.85 bishii (2023).Xaq uma laha fasax, laakiin caymis caafimaad.Canshuur iyo badbaado bulsho oo bilaash ah.
entity2.id2.entry4.title: Qandaraaska shaqada & kuwa xorta ah
entity2.id2.entry4.subtitle: Ma aha shaqaale, laakiin waa dad iskood u shaqeysta.Xuquuqo yar ( fasax la'aan, ilaalin la'aan cayrinta).Iska jir iskaa u shaqeysiga beenta ah!
entity2.id3.title: Mushaharka & Mushaharka
entity2.id3.subtitle: Xuquuqda lacag bixinta
entity2.id3.entry1.title: Mushaharka ugu yar
entity2.id3.entry1.subtitle: Ma jiro mushaharka ugu yar ee qaanuuniga ah ee guud, laakiin heshiisyada wadajirka ah ayaa nidaamiya mushaharka ugu yar ee warshadaha gaarka ah.KV la'aanteed, mushaharka caadiga ah ee suuqa ayaa khuseeya.
entity2.id3.entry2.title: Bixinta mushaharka
entity2.id3.entry2.subtitle: Mushaharka waa in lagu bixiyaa bil kasta, waqtigeeda iyo euro.Bixinta lacag caddaan ah oo keliya oggolaansho.Warqadaha mushaharka ee la helay (payslips).
entity2.id3.entry3.title: saacadaha dheeraadka ah
entity2.id3.entry3.subtitle: Ugu badnaan 5 saacadood oo dheeraad ah maalintii, 60 saacadood todobaadkii oo ay ku jiraan saacadaha dheeraadka ah.Kharash dheeraad ah ugu yaraan 50% ama magdhowga wakhtiga.
entity2.id3.entry4.title: Habeen iyo axad shaqada
entity2.id3.entry4.subtitle: Shaqada habeenkii (8 p.m.-5 a.m.): Kharashka ugu yar ee 50%.Axadaha iyo ciidaha guud: kharashka ugu yar ee 100%.Marka laga reebo warshadaha qaarkood.
entity2.id4.title: Saacadaha shaqada iyo nasashada
entity2.id4.subtitle: Xuduudaha sharciga ah
entity2.id4.entry1.title: Saacadaha shaqada ee maalinlaha ah
entity2.id4.entry1.subtitle: Ugu badnaan 8 saacadood maalintii, 40 saacadood toddobaadkii (celcelis ahaan).Ka-reebitaanka suurtogalka ah ilaa 10 saacadood maalintii.
entity2.id4.entry2.title: Nasasho
entity2.id4.entry2.subtitle: 6-9 saacadood oo shaqo ah: 30 daqiiqo nasasho.Haddii ay ka badan tahay 9 saacadood: 45 daqiiqo nasasho.Nasashada waa la wadaagi karaa (ugu yaraan 15 daqiiqo).
entity2.id4.entry3.title: Xilliyada nasashada
entity2.id4.entry3.subtitle: Muddada nasashada maalinlaha ah: Ugu yaraan 11 saacadood inta u dhaxaysa saacadaha shaqada.Muddada nasashada toddobaadlaha ah: Ugu yaraan 36 saacadood si joogto ah.
entity2.id4.entry4.title: Wakhtiga dabacsan
entity2.id4.entry4.subtitle: Saacadaha shaqada ee dabacsan oo ku jira qaab-dhismeedka wakhtiga dabacsan.Wakhtiga muhiimka ah ( imaanshaha qasabka ah) iyo wakhtiga dabacsanaanta (jadwalka bilaashka ah).
entity2.id5.title: Fasax xanuun iyo jirro
entity2.id5.subtitle: Xuquuqda haddii ay dhacdo xanuun
entity2.id5.entry1.title: Qoraal xanuun
entity2.id5.entry1.subtitle: Haddii aad jirran tahay, isla markiiba u sheeg cidda aad u shaqayso!Dhakhtar u tag oo hel caddaynta karti-darrada shaqada (e-card).
entity2.id5.entry2.title: Bixinta mushaharka oo sii socota
entity2.id5.entry2.subtitle: Bixinta mushaharka oo buuxa muddo 6-10 toddobaad ah taas oo ku xidhan sanadaha adeegga.Ka dib mushaharka bukaanka ee shirkadda caymiska caafimaadka (qiyaastii. 60% mushaharka).
entity2.id5.entry3.title: Muddada sugitaanka
entity2.id5.entry3.subtitle: Ma jiro wakhti sugitaan haddii ay dhacdo shil ama jirro shaqo.Cudurada kale: 1 maalin oo fasax waalid ah (mushahar la'aan) haddii xiriirka shaqadu ka yar yahay 1 bil.
entity2.id5.entry4.title: Booqo dhakhtarka wakhtiga shaqada
entity2.id5.entry4.subtitle: Booqashada dhakhtarka ayaa suurtagal ah saacadaha shaqada.Waa in lagu ogeysiiyaa loo shaqeeyaha.Waqtiga waxaa loo bixiyaa si caadi ah.
entity2.id6.title: Fasaxa & Madadaalada
entity2.id6.subtitle: Xaq u yeelashada fasaxa sharciga ah
entity2.id6.entry1.title: Fasaxa sanadlaha ah
entity2.id6.entry1.subtitle: Ugu yaraan 25 maalmood oo fasax ah sannadkii (5 toddobaad).Iyadoo heshiis wadareed inta badan 30 maalmood (6 toddobaad).
entity2.id6.entry2.title: Mushaharka fasaxa
entity2.id6.entry2.subtitle: Mushaharka ka sokow: mushaharka fasaxa (mushaharka 1 bil) iyo gunnada kirismaska ​​(mushaharka 1 bil).Inta badan bilaha Juun iyo November.
entity2.id6.entry3.title: Fasax gaar ah
entity2.id6.entry3.subtitle: Lacag bixinta: Aroos (1 maalin), dhimashada qaraabo dhow (1-3 maalmood), dhalashada ilmo (1 maalin).Lacag la'aan: Daryeelida carruurta jiran.
entity2.id6.entry4.title: Fasaxa waalidka
entity2.id6.entry4.subtitle: Labada waalidba waxay xaq u leeyihiin fasax waalidnimo ilaa ilmuhu ka gaadhayo dhalashadii labaad.Kaalmada daryeelka ilmaha ee gobolka inta lagu jiro wakhtigan.
entity2.id7.title: Ilaalinta hooyada iyo fasaxa waalidka
entity2.id7.subtitle: Xuquuqda ilaalinta gaarka ah
entity2.id7.entry1.title: Fasaxa dhalmada
entity2.id7.entry1.subtitle: Mamnuucida shaqada 8 usbuuc ka hor iyo 8 usbuuc ka dib dhalashada.Bixinta mushaharka oo buuxa.Ka-hortagga cayrinta xilliga uurka iyo 4 bilood ka dib dhalashada.
entity2.id7.entry2.title: Fasaxa aabbanimada
entity2.id7.entry2.subtitle: Aabbuhu wuxuu xaq u leeyahay 1 bilood oo fasax mushahar ah markuu dhasho ("bisha aabbaha").Waa in lagu qaataa 3 bilood gudahood dhalashada.
entity2.id7.entry3.title: Fasaxa waalidka
entity2.id7.entry3.subtitle: Fasaxa umusha ka dib: Xaq u lahaanshaha shaqaaleysiinta wakhti dhiman ilaa ilmuhu ka gaadhayo 7 jir.Loo shaqeeyuhu waa inuu ku heshiiyaa, ilaa sababo hawleed ka soo horjeedaan.
entity2.id7.entry4.title: : gunnada xannaanada carruurta
entity2.id7.entry4.subtitle: Dheefaha gobolka inta lagu jiro fasaxa umusha: Kala duwanaanshaha 12-36 bilood.Qadarka ayaa ku xidhan doorashada la doortay iyo dakhligii hore.
entity2.id8.title: Ururada shaqaalaha iyo golayaasha shaqada
entity2.id8.subtitle: U doodid wadareed
entity2.id8.entry1.title: Ku biirista urur shaqaale
entity2.id8.entry1.subtitle: Iskaa wax u qabso ah.Wax ku biirinta: qiyaastii 1% mushaharka guud.Faa'iidooyinka: La-talinta sharciga, taageerada shaqo joojinta, gorgortanka heshiisyada wadajirka ah.
entity2.id8.entry2.title: Heshiis wadareed
entity2.id8.entry2.subtitle: Heshiiska warshadaha oo dhan ee u dhexeeya ururka shaqaalaha iyo ururka loo shaqeeyaha.Dejiya mushaharka ugu yar, saacadaha shaqada, gunnooyinka.Ku xidhnaanta dhammaan shirkadaha ku jira warshadaha.
entity2.id8.entry3.title: Golaha shaqada
entity2.id8.entry3.subtitle: Waxaa lagu dooran karaa shirkado leh 5 ama in ka badan oo shaqaale ah.Wuxuu matalaa danaha shaqaalaha wuxuuna xaq u leeyahay in la go'aamiyo arrimaha shaqaalaha.
entity2.id8.entry4.title: Xaqqa shaqo-joojin
entity2.id8.entry4.subtitle: Xuquuqda aasaasiga ah, laakiin leh shuruudo: Waajibka in la sameeyo nabad inta lagu jiro heshiisyada wadajirka ah ee socda, codeyn shaqo joojin ayaa loo baahan yahay.Mushahar la'aan muddada shaqo joojinta
entity2.id9.title: Joojinta iyo Joojinta
entity2.id9.subtitle: Joojinta xiriirka shaqada
entity2.id9.entry1.title: Xilliyada ogeysiiska
entity2.id9.entry1.subtitle: Waxay ku xiran tahay sanadaha adeegga: Ilaa 2 sano: 6 toddobaad, 2-5 sano: 2 bilood, 5-15 sano: 3 bilood, 15-25 sano: 4 bilood, ka badan 25 sano: 5 bilood.
entity2.id9.entry2.title: Ka-hortagga xil ka qaadista
entity2.id9.entry2.subtitle: Ilaalinta gaarka ah: haweenka uurka leh, waalidiinta fasaxa umusha ku jira, xubnaha golaha shaqada, dadka aad naafada ah, tababarayaasha.Shaqo ka cayrin bulsho oo aan cudur daar lahayn ayaa laga hor iman karaa.
entity2.id9.entry3.title: Magdhawga cayrinta
entity2.id9.entry3.subtitle: Haddi uu shaqada ka joojiyo loo shaqeeyuhu in ka badan 3 sano oo adeeg ah ka dib: ka joojinta bixinta mushaharka 2 bilood ee sanadka adeega (ugu badnaan 12 bilood).
entity2.id9.entry4.title: Heshiiska joojinta
entity2.id9.entry4.subtitle: Joojinta xiriirka shaqo ee heshiis labada dhinac ah.Badana waxay la xiriirtaa mushaharka shaqada.Faa'iidada: Xaq u yeelashada degdega ah ee faa'iidooyinka shaqo la'aanta.
entity2.id10.title: Takoorka iyo cagajuglaynta
entity2.id10.subtitle: Ka ilaalinta takoorka
entity2.id10.entry1.title: Daawaynta siman
entity2.id10.entry1.subtitle: Takoorka ku salaysan jinsiga, da'da, diinta, asalka, naafanimada ama nooca galmada waa mamnuuc.Sheegashada waxyeelada suurtagalka ah.
entity2.id10.entry2.title: cagajuglaynta
entity2.id10.entry2.subtitle: Dhibaataynta habaysan ee goobta shaqada waa mamnuuc.Ka qaybgal golaha shaqada ama qareenka sinaanta.Dukumeentiyada dhammaan dhacdooyinka
entity2.id10.entry3.title: Dhibaataynta galmada
entity2.id10.entry3.subtitle: La ciqaabi karo!Isla markaaba u wargeli madaxdaada, golaha shaqada ama waaxda shaqaalaha.Loo-shaqeeyaha waa in uu tallaabo qaado.
entity2.id10.entry4.title: Qodobbada cabashada
entity2.id10.entry4.subtitle: Kormeeraha shaqada, qareenka sinaanta, rugta shaqaalaha, ururka shaqaalaha.Talo iyo taageero bilaash ah.

entity4.id8.entry3.title: Haweenka & kuwa soo laabtay
entity4.id8.entry3.subtitle: Talooyinka haweenka, koorsooyinka haweenka ku soo laabanaya shaqada, kaalmaynta isku dheelitirka qoyska iyo shaqada iyo xarumaha adeegga haweenka ee gobol kasta oo federaal ah.
entity4.id8.entry4.title: Muhaajiriinta & qaxootiga
entity4.id8.entry4.subtitle: Talooyin ku qoran luqado kala duwan, koorsooyinka Jarmal la beegsaday (BERUF), aqoonsiga shahaadooyinka ajnabiga ah iyo barnaamijyada isdhexgalka suuqa shaqada.
entity5.id1.title: Aasaaska aqoonsiga
entity5.id1.subtitle: Goorma ayaa loo baahan yahay aqoonsiga rasmiga ah?
entity5.id1.entry1.title: Laba nooc oo xirfado ah
entity5.id1.entry1.subtitle: Waxa la kala soocaa mihnadaha la habeeyey iyo kuwa aan sharciyeysnayn.Xirfadaha la habeeyey (sida dhakhtarka, naqshadeeyaha, macalinka), aqoonsiga waa qasab si loo awoodo in uu ku shaqeeyo xirfadda.Xirfadaha aan sharciga ahayn (sida karraaniga xafiiska, khabiir IT) badanaa waa ikhtiyaari, laakiin muhiim u ah loo-shaqeeyayaasha.
entity5.id1.entry2.title: Faa'iidooyinka aqoonsiga
entity5.id1.entry2.subtitle: Aqoonsiga rasmiga ah wuxuu ka dhigayaa shahaadadaada mid muuqata oo la barbar dhigi karo suuqa shaqada ee Austria.Waxay kordhisaa fursadahaaga shaqo, inta badan waxay awood u siinaysaa mushahar sare waxayna shardi u tahay inaad bilowdo kooras waxbarasho ama lagu galo koorsooyin tababar dheeraad ah.
entity5.id1.entry3.title: Mabaadi'da ugu muhiimsan
entity5.id1.entry3.subtitle: Nidaamka aqoonsiga Awstaria wuxuu raacayaa tilmaamaha aqoonsiga xirfadeed ee Midowga Yurub iyo mabda'a nostrification.Waa la eegi doonaa in shahaadadaada shisheeye ay u dhiganto mid Australiya ah.U dhigmidda dhammaystiran mar walba lagama maarmaan ma aha;U dhigma shuruudaha (shahaadada xigta) ayaa badanaa ku filan.
entity5.id1.entry4.title: Hel hay'ado mas'uul ah
entity5.id1.entry4.subtitle: Hay'adda mas'uulka ah waxay ku xiran tahay xirfadda ama aqoonta.Shahaadooyinka dugsiga inta badan waa agaasinka waxbarashada ee gobolka federaalka, shahaadooyinka jaamacadeed waa jaamacadaha dadweynaha, xirfadaha la nidaamiyo waa ururka xirfadlayaasha (sida ururka caafimaadka).
entity5.id2.title: Aqoonsiga shahaadooyinka dugsiga
entity5.id2.subtitle: Shahaadada bixitaanka dugsiga dhexe, Matura, Abitur
entity5.id2.entry1.title: Ujeedada aqoonsiga dugsiga
entity5.id2.entry1.subtitle: Aqoonsiga shahaadooyinka dugsiga ajnabiga ah badanaa waa lagama maarmaan si loo bilaabo shaqo-barasho gudaha Austria, si aad wax uga barato jaamacad ama kulliyad farsamo ama si aad u hesho tababar xirfadeed gaar ah (sida qaybta daryeelka caafimaadka).
entity5.id2.entry2.title: Hay’ado mas’uul ah
entity5.id2.entry2.subtitle: Waxaa mas'uul ka ah agaasinka waxbarashada ee dowlad goboleedyada federaalka ah.Jaamacadda la doonayo lafteeda ayaa inta badan mas'uul ka ah aqoonsiga shahaadada gelitaanka jaamacadda guud (tusaale Matura, Abitur) ee koorsada waxbarasho.
entity5.id2.entry3.title: Dukumentiyada loo baahan yahay
entity5.id2.entry3.subtitle: Sida caadiga ah, waxaad u baahan doontaa: Shahaadada asalka ah ama nuqul la aqoonsan yahay, tarjumaad rasmi ah oo la aqoonsan yahay (turjumaan maxkamadeed oo ay maxkamaddu caddaynayso) oo Jarmal ah, caddaynta dhererka daraasadda iyo maaddooyinka la qaatay (jadwalka wakhtiga), badanaa sidoo kale warqad caddayn ah oo caddayn ah.
entity5.id2.entry4.title: Shuruudaha suurtagalka ah
entity5.id2.entry4.subtitle: Haddii ay jiraan farqi weyn oo u dhexeeya manhajka Austria, imtixaanno dheeri ah ayaa lagu soo rogi karaa maaddooyinka qaarkood (tusaale Jarmal, xisaab, taariikh).Haddii aad tan ku gudubto, shahaadada waxaa loo tixgelinayaa mid la aqoonsan yahay.
entity5.id3.title: Aqoonsiga shahaadooyinka jaamacadda (nostrification)
entity5.id3.subtitle: Bachelor, Master, Doctorate
entity5.id3.entry1.title: Waa maxay Nostrification?
entity5.id3.entry1.subtitle: Nostrification waa nidaamka sinnaanta rasmiga ah ee shahaadooyin jaamacadeed ajnabi ah oo haysta shahaado Austrian ah.Waxay xaqiijisaa u dhigmidda sayniska waxayna xaq kuu siinaysaa inaad haysato shahaadada akadeemiyadeed ee u dhiganta (tusaale 'Master of Science, M.Sc.').
entity5.id3.entry2.title: Jaamacadaha mas'uulka ah
entity5.id3.entry2.subtitle: Nostrification had iyo jeer waxaa fulisa jaamacad dadweyne oo Austrian ah oo bixisa koorsooyin kala duwan oo la mid ah.Shahaadada koowaad ee injineernimada farsamada waxaa baaray TU Vienna, tusaale ahaan.Mareegta www.ancognition.at waxay kaa caawinaysaa inaad hesho hay'adda ka mas'uulka ah.
entity5.id3.entry3.title: Documents & Turjumaada
entity5.id3.entry3.subtitle: Kuwa soo socda ayaa lagama maarmaan ah: diblooma/shahaadad (la xaqiijiyay), kabka dibloomada ama sharaxaada cutubka oo faahfaahsan, CV, baasaboor.Dhammaan dukumeentiyada waa in si rasmi ah loo xaqiijiyaa oo loo turjumaa Jarmalka.Apostille ama sharciyeyn ayaa badanaa loo baahan yahay.
entity5.id3.entry4.title: Habka tijaabada & shuruudaha
entity5.id3.entry4.subtitle: Jaamacaddu waxay hubisaa nuxurka, baaxadda iyo muddada koorsada waxbarashadu.Haddii ay dhacdo leexleexdu, waxa ay u baahan kartaa imtixaanno sanqadhyo (maado gaar ah) ama dhammaystirka shahaadadda sare.Haddii ay jiraan kala duwanaansho weyn, kaliya sanka qayb ka mid ah ayaa lagu dhawaaqaa.
entity5.id4.title: Aqoonsiga xirfadaha la habeeyey
entity5.id4.subtitle: Dhakhaatiir, injineero, macalimiin, kalkaalisooyin
entity5.id4.entry1.title: Waa maxay xirfadaha la nidaamiyay?
entity5.id4.entry1.subtitle: Kuwani waa xirfado ay ku dhaqankoodu si sharci ah ugu xidhan yahay haysashada shahaado gaar ah si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka ama badbaadada bulshada.Aqoonsiga buuxa ("ogolaanshaha xirfadeed") waa waajibaad sharci ah halkan.Tusaalooyinka: dhakhtarka, farmashiistaha, naqshadeeyaha, cilmi-nafsiga, macalinka, injineerka korontada.
entity5.id4.entry2.title: Golayaasha mas'uulka ah & maamulka
entity5.id4.entry2.subtitle: Xirfad kastaa waxay leedahay qol mas'uul ah oo u gaar ah ama awood u gaar ah: xirfadaha caafimaadka rugta caafimaadka ama caafimaadka ee gobolka, injineerada Rugta Injineerada, macalimiinta Wasaaradda Waxbarashada Federaalka.Liiska boosaska oo dhan waxaad ka heli kartaa www.berufsanwissen.at.
entity5.id4.entry3.title: Habka gaarka ah
entity5.id4.entry3.subtitle: Imtixaanka shahaadooyinka ka sokow, imtixaan aqooneed ama koorsada la qabsiga (tababarka kormeerka) ayaa badanaa loo baahan yahay.Muwaaddiniinta EU/EEA, nidaamka la dedejiyey ayaa khuseeya sida uu qabo Awaamiirta Aqoonsiga Xirfadlayaasha Midowga Yurub.Nidaamku inta badan aad ayuu ugu adag yahay muwaadiniinta waddan saddexaad.
entity5.id4.entry4.title: Shahaadada luqadda
entity5.id4.entry4.subtitle: Ku dhawaad ​​dhammaan xirfadaha sharciga ah, caddaynta xirfadaha luqadda Jarmalka ee heerka B2 ama C1 (GER) waa qasab ka hor inta aan la soo gudbin codsiga.Tusaale ahaan, shahaadooyinka ÖSD, Goethe ama telc waa la aqoonsan yahay.
entity5.id5.title: Qiimaynta xirfadaha aan sharciyeysnayn & waayo-aragnimada xirfadeed
entity5.id5.subtitle: Shahaadooyinka tababarka, tababarka, waxbarashada aan rasmiga ahayn
entity5.id5.entry1.title: Qiimaynta iskaa wax u qabso ah
entity5.id5.entry1.subtitle: Ma jirto wax shuruud ah oo lagu aqoonsanayo xirfadaha aan sharciga ahayn (tusaale, cunto karinta, karraaniga tafaariiqda, horumariyaha software).Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa macno leh in shahaadooyinkaaga ay si rasmi ah u qiimeeyaan Rugta Ganacsiga (WKO) ama AMS si ay u fahmaan loo shaqeeyaha.
entity5.id5.entry2.title: Aqoonsiga waayo-aragnimada xirfadeed
entity5.id5.entry2.subtitle: Awoodaha lagu helay si aan rasmi ahayn (iyada oo loo marayo sanado badan oo waayo-aragnimo xirfadeed ah) sidoo kale waa la aqoonsan karaa!Habka waxaa loo yaqaan "Ansaxinta xirfadaha aan rasmiga ahayn iyo kuwa aan rasmiga ahayn".Waxay inta badan ku dhammaataa shahaado rasmi ah (tusaale "shahaadada AMS ee kartida").
entity5.id5.entry3.title: Qiimaynta kartida
entity5.id5.entry3.subtitle: Habka qiimaynta (wada-hadallada, layliyada la taaban karo, muunado shaqo) xirfadahaaga waa la falanqeeyaa oo marka la barbar dhigo astaanta xirfadlaha Australiya.Tan waxaa lagu samayn karaa AMS, xarumaha macluumaadka shaqada (BIZ) ama machadyada gaarka ah sida abif.
entity5.id5.entry4.title: Natiijo iyo faa'iido
entity5.id5.entry4.subtitle: Waxaad heli doontaa warbixin ama shahaado rasmi ah oo caddaynaysa xirfadahaaga.Dukumeentigan waxaad ku soo lifaaqi kartaa codsiyo.Waxa kale oo ay muujin kartaa shahaadooyinka maqan ee aad u baahan tahay si aad u hesho shahaadada rasmiga ah.
entity5.id6.title: Habka wax ku oolka ah, kharashyada iyo muddada
entity5.id6.subtitle: Maxaa la filayaa
entity5.id6.entry1.title: Habka tallaabo-tallaabo
entity5.id6.entry1.subtitle:
1. Hel talo (tusaale ka AST).
2. Go'aami hay'adda mas'uulka ah.
3. Ururi dukumeenti, ha la caddeeyo oo la turjumo.
4. Soo gudbi codsiga dhammaan dukumeentiyada.
5. Buuxi nidaamyada iyo imtixaan kasta/shuruudaha.
6. Ogeysiinta (shahaada aqoonsiga) oo la helay.
entity5.id6.entry2.title: Qiimaha & Khidmadaha
entity5.id6.entry2.subtitle: Kharashyadu aad bay u kala duwan yihiin: shahaadooyinka iyo tarjumaada (€ 50-150 dukumeentiba), khidmadaha maamulka ee xafiiska aqoonsiga (€ 100-600), kharashyada imtixaannada dheeriga ah ama koorsooyinka (waxay noqon kartaa dhowr kun oo Yuuro).Inta badan waxa jira doorashooyin lagu daboolayo kharashaadka kuwa xaqa u leh magangelyo iyo kuwa xaqa u leh ilaalinta hoose.
entity5.id6.entry3.title: Muddada habraaca
entity5.id6.entry3.subtitle: Muddadu waxay ku xidhan tahay dhammaystirka dukumeentigaaga iyo nooca nidaamka: Shahaadooyinka dugsiga: 1-3 bilood.Sanka: 3-9 bilood Xirfadaha la maamulo (EU): ilaa 4 bilood.Xirfadaha la maamulo (wadanka saddexaad): 6 bilood ilaa dhowr sano.Qorshee waqti ku filan!
entity5.id6.entry4.title: Daawooyinka sharciga ah
entity5.id6.entry4.subtitle: Waxaad soo gudbin kartaa ashtako ka dhan ah go'aan diidmo ah ama shuruudo aan dheellitirnayn 4 toddobaad gudahood.Hubi inaad taageero ka raadsato xarunta la-talinta sharciga (tusaale, Rugta Shaqaalaha ama xarunta la-talinta muhaajiriinta).
entity5.id7.title: Taageero iyo talo
entity5.id7.subtitle: Hel gargaar bilaash ah
entity5.id7.entry1.title: Barta Xiriirka Aqoonsiga (AST)
entity5.id7.entry1.subtitle: "Barta Xiriirka Aqoonsiga" waa dawladda dhexe ee dhexe, xarun talobixin bilaash ah.Waxay kaa caawinaysaa inaad hesho xafiiska mas'uulka ka ah, waxay kuu sharxaysaa habraaca waxayna kugu taageertaa ururinta dukumentiyada.La xidhiidh: Telefoon +43 1 531 20 0, iimaylka: ancognition@bmbwf.gv.at.
entity5.id7.entry2.title: Xarumaha la talinta socdaalka
entity5.id7.entry2.subtitle: Ururada ay ka midka yihiin Caritas, Diakonie, Volkshilfe iyo xarumaha latalinta soogalootiga ayaa bixiya talobixin gaar ah oo ku saabsan arimaha aqoonsiga dadka asalkoodu yahay soogalootiga, oo badiyaa ku hadla luqado kala duwan.
entity5.id7.entry3.title: AMS & xarumaha macluumaadka shaqada (BIZ)
entity5.id7.entry3.subtitle: AMS waxay ka talisaa aqoonsiga xirfadeed ee qayb ka ah isdhexgalka shaqada waxayna ku siin kartaa maalgelin hababka aqoonsiga ama shahaadooyinka xiga ee lagama maarmaanka ah.Waxaad ka heli kartaa macluumaadka ku saabsan profiles-xirfadeedka BIS.
entity5.id7.entry4.title: Fursadaha maalgelinta
entity5.id7.entry4.subtitle: Shuruudaha qaarkood, AMS, ÖIF (Sanduuqa Is-dhexgalka Australiya) ama lacagaha sida MYKI (Aqoonsiga Soogalootiga) ayaa daboolaya qaybo ka mid ah kharashyada tarjumaada, khidmadaha ama koorsooyinka loo baahan yahay.Weydii xaruntaada talo wax ku saabsan!
entity5.id8.title: Beddelka aqoonsiga buuxa
entity5.id8.subtitle: Haddii sanqadh-qabashada aanay suurtogal ahayn (isla markiiba).
entity5.id8.entry1.title: Shahaadada ka dib & tababar dheeraad ah
entity5.id8.entry1.subtitle: Haddii shahaadadaada aan si buuxda loo aqoonsan, waxaad la qabsan kartaa xirfadaha maqan.AMS waxay inta badan taageertaa koorsooyinka, layliyo ama dib u qaadashada imtixaanada qayb ahaan si loo helo aqoonsi.
entity5.id8.entry2.title: Ka shaqaynta boosaska caawinta
entity5.id8.entry2.subtitle: Xirfadaha qaarkood ee la habeeyey (tusaale kalkaalisada, farsamada) waxa suurtogal ah in aad marka hore u shaqayso kaaliye ama kaaliye inta aad isu diyaarinayso aqoonsi buuxa oo barbar socda.Tani waxay ku siinaysaa khibrad wax ku ool ah iyo dakhli.
entity5.id8.entry3.title: Aqoonsiga kartida qaybeed
entity5.id8.entry3.subtitle: Xitaa haddii dhammaan shahaadooyinka aan la aqoonsan, maadooyinka gaarka ah ama cutubyada waa la qaddarin karaa - tusaale ahaan marka wax lagu baranayo hadhow Austria.Hayso warbixin tafatiran oo la soo saaray oo tusinaysa qaybahan u dhigma.
entity5.id8.entry4.title: Codsiga ku jihaysan kartida
entity5.id8.entry4.subtitle: Codsigaaga, diirada saar xirfadahaaga gaarka ah iyo khibradaada xirfadeed, kaliya maahan cinwaanka rasmiga ah.Tilmaamaha xirfadaha xirfadeed ama waraaqaha tixraaca ee loo-shaqeeyayaashii hore waxay qayb ahaan magdhabi karaan la'aanta shahaadada Australiya.
entity6.id1.title: Tababarka laba-geesoodka ah - qaabka Austrian ee guusha
entity6.id1.subtitle: Ku tababaro shirkadda iyo aragtida dugsiga farsamada gacanta
entity6.id1.entry1.title: Waa maxay caqiidada?
entity6.id1.entry1.subtitle: Tababarka laba-geesoodka ah waa qaabka ugu badan ee tababarka Austria.Tababar ahaan, waxaad ka shaqeysaa shirkad 3-4 maalmood asbuucii waxaadna dhigataa dugsi xirfadeed 1-2 maalmood.Tababarku wuxuu socdaa 2-4 sano wuxuuna ku dhamaanayaa imtixaanka ugu dambeeya ee tababarka shaqada (LAP).
entity6.id1.entry2.title: Faa'iidooyinka waxbaridda
entity6.id1.entry2.subtitle: Waxaad helaysaa lacag bilawga bilawga (magdhowga tababarka shaqada), waxaad helaysaa waayo-aragnimo wax ku ool ah oo aad hesho fursado shaqo oo aad u wanaagsan ka dib qalin-jabinta.Waxa jira in ka badan 200 oo shaqo-barasho oo laga kala dooranayo, min injineernimada korantada ilaa tafaariiqda iyo tignoolajiyada macluumaadka.
entity6.id1.entry3.title: Shuruudaha
entity6.id1.entry3.subtitle: Shuruuda ugu yar ayaa badanaa ah in la dhammeeyo fasalka 9aad (dugsiga khasabka ah).Xirfadaha qaarkood, dhammaystir wanaagsan oo ah fasalka 8aad ama 9aad ee maadooyinka qaarkood ayaa loo baahan yahay.Da'da ugu yar waa 15 sano.
entity6.id1.entry4.title: Goob-barasho shaqo
entity6.id1.entry4.subtitle: Waxaad ka heli kartaa shaqo-barasho gudaha AMS eJob Room, xafiiska shaqada ee WKO, si toos ah shirkadaha ama carwooyinka ganacsiga sida BeSt³.Codsiga aan la rabin ee shirkadaha aan si cad u eegin waa mid guul leh.
entity6.id2.title: Dugsiyada farsamada gacanta (BMS/BHS)
entity6.id2.subtitle: Dugsiyo waqti-buuxa ah oo loogu talagalay shahaadooyinka sare
entity6.id2.entry1.title: Dugsiga dhexe ee farsamada gacanta (BMS)
entity6.id2.entry1.subtitle: Muddada: 1-4 sano.Degree: Shahaado shaqaale xirfad leh ama imtixaan kama dambays ah.BMS waxay kuu diyaarinaysaa xirfad gaar ah (tusaale kaaliyaha kalkaalinta, injineernimada korontada, xafiiska).Qaarkood waxay ku dhameeyaan imtixaankii ugu dambeeyay ee shaqo-barasho.
entity6.id2.entry2.title: Dugsiga sare ee farsamada gacanta (BHS)
entity6.id2.entry2.subtitle: Muddada: 5 sano.U qalmida: Imtixaanka shahaadiga iyo dibloomada (Matura + shahaado xirfadeed).BHS (sida HTL, HAK, HLW) waxay bixisaa tababar xirfadeed oo buuxa iyo shahaadooyin gelitaanka jaamacadda guud.Rajo shaqo oo aad u wanaagsan!
entity6.id2.entry3.title: Shuruudaha gelitaanka
entity6.id2.entry3.subtitle: Loogu talagalay BMS: Dhammaystir wanaagsan ee fasalka 8aad.Loogu talagalay BHS: Dhammaystir wanaagsan oo fasalka 8aad ah, oo inta badan lagu galo imtixaannada Jarmalka, xisaabta iyo Ingiriisiga.Haddii dalabku uu xad dhaaf yahay, waxaa jira nidaam ogolaansho.
entity6.id2.entry4.title: Kharashyada iyo maalgelinta
entity6.id2.entry4.subtitle: Dugsiyada farsamada gacanta dadweynuhu waa bilaash.Kharashyada agabka (aqoon-is-weydaarsiga, dharka karinta) ayaa laga yaabaa inay khuseeyaan.Waxaa jira dugsiyo fiidkii oo gaar ah oo loogu talagalay dadka waaweyn (2 sano kadib qalin-jabinta).
entity6.id3.title: Koorsooyinka waxbarashada dadka waaweyn
entity6.id3.subtitle: Tababar dheeraad ah oo ay weheliso shaqadaada
entity6.id3.entry1.title: WiFi iyo BFI
entity6.id3.entry1.subtitle: Machadyada Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha (WiFi) ee Rugta Ganacsiga iyo Machadyada Horumarinta Xirfadaha (BFI) waxay bixiyaan kumanaan koorasyo: laga bilaabo farsamada iyo farsamada ilaa xafiis iyo maarayn ilaa luqadaha iyo IT.Shahaadooyinka: shahaadooyin, shahaado, imtixaan heer sare ah.
entity6.id3.entry2.title: Xarumaha waxbarashada dadka waaweyn (VHS)
entity6.id3.entry2.subtitle: Xarumaha waxbarashada dadka waaweyn waxay bixiyaan koorsooyin kala duwan oo jaban oo loogu talagalay dhammaan danaha: luqadaha, caafimaadka, hal-abuurka, waxbarashada aasaasiga ah iyo xirfadaha xirfadeed ee muhiimka ah (tusaale IT, tababarka codsiga).
entity6.id3.entry3.title: Xarumaha waxbarashada & akadeemiyada
entity6.id3.entry3.subtitle: Bixiyeyaasha waxbarashada gaarka ah iyo kuwa diiniga ah (tusaale Xarunta Waxbarashada Katooliga, xarumaha waxbarashada gobolka) waxay bixiyaan siminaaro iyo tababaro wakhti dheer ah, inta badana diirada saaraya mawduucyada bulshada, waxbarashada ama shakhsiyadda dhista.
entity6.id3.entry4.title: Goobaha waxbarashada onlaynka ah
entity6.id3.entry4.subtitle: Goobaha MOOC (sida iMoox.at), goobta waxbarashada ÖIF (sprachportal.at) ama koorsooyinka Udemy iyo Coursera waxay awood u siinayaan waxbarasho dabacsan.Inta badan waxaad heli doontaa shahaadooyin ka qaybqaadasho, kuwaas oo qiimo ku leh CV-gaaga.

entity6.id4.entry1.title: Dhamaystirka waxbarashada khasabka ah
entity6.id4.entry1.subtitle: Qof kasta oo dhammaystay 9 sano oo dugsi hoose ah oo aan natiijo wanaagsani ka soo bixin waxa uu ku samayn karaa lacag la'aan.Soo jeedinta waxaa laga heli karaa BFI, VHS iyo bixiyeyaasha kale.Badanaa qaab modular ah, sidoo kale suurtogal ah waqti-dhiman.
entity6.id4.entry2.title: Imtixaanka maturity xirfadeed (BRP)
entity6.id4.entry2.subtitle: BRP waa bedelka buuxa ee Matura ee dadka leh shahaado tababar ama khibrad xirfadeed.Waxay ka kooban tahay 4 imtixaan oo qayb ah (Jarmalka, xisaabta, luqad shisheeye nool, maadada) waxayna xaq kuu siinaysaa inaad wax ka barato jaamacadaha, kulliyadaha farsamada iyo kulliyadaha.
entity6.id4.entry3.title: Imtixaanka gelitaanka waxbarashada (SBP)
entity6.id4.entry3.subtitle: SBP waxay xaq kuu siinaysaa inaad maaddo gaar ah ka barato jaamacadaha iyo kulliyadaha farsamada adigoon haysan shahaado dugsi sare.Si gaar ah ayaa la isugu geeyay oo ka kooban dhowr imtixaan oo daboolaya aqoontii hore ee loo baahnaa.
entity6.id4.entry4.title: Koorasyada diyaarinta
entity6.id4.entry4.subtitle: WiFi, BFI, VHS iyo bixiyeyaasha gaarka ah waxay bixiyaan koorsooyin diyaarinta BRP iyo SBP.Koorsooyinka waa la maalgelin karaa (tusaale, AMS, Rugta Shaqaalaha ama WAFF ee Vienna).
entity6.id5.title: Tababar iyo waxbarasho dheeraad ah oo ay maalgeliso AMS
entity6.id5.subtitle: Shahaado bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay shaqo-doonka
entity6.id5.entry1.title: Koorasyada Jarmalka
entity6.id5.entry1.subtitle: AMS-du waxay maalgelisaa koorsooyinka Jarmalka ee A1 ilaa C1, gaar ahaan koorasyada BERUF ee Jarmalka, kuwaas oo baraya Jarmalka shaqada.Koorsooyinka A1 iyo A2 inta badan waa qasab kuwa xaqa u leh magangalyada iyo kuwa xaqa u leh ilaalinta hoose.
entity6.id5.entry2.title: Tababarka codsiga & tababarka xirfadaha
entity6.id5.entry2.subtitle: Koorsooyin bilaash ah oo ku saabsan CV, codsi online ah, wareysi iyo is-muujin.Koorasyada xirfadaha dhijitaalka ah ee aasaasiga ah ama maaraynta mashruuca ayaa sidoo kale la bixiyaa.
entity6.id5.entry3.title: Dib u tabobar iyo tababar takhasus leh
entity6.id5.entry3.subtitle: AMS-du waxay maalgelisaa dib-u-tababar dhamaystiran oo ku saabsan shaqooyinka yaraanta (tusaale kalkaalisada, IT, injineernimada korantada, saadka bakhaarka).Tababarku wuxuu ka dhacaa xarumaha waxbarashada, inta badan ay ku jiraan tababaro.Waxaad heli doontaa lacag taageero ah inta lagu jiro tababarkaaga.
entity6.id5.entry4.title: Shahaadada waxbarashada ee dadka waaweyn
entity6.id5.entry4.subtitle: Iyadoo loo marayo barnaamijka "Tabbarka Tababarka Matura" ama "Imtixaanka Tababarka Dhameystiran ee Dadka Waaweyn" dadka waaweyn waxay ku heli karaan shahaadada tababarka muddo gaaban (1-2 sano).AMS waxay dabooshaa kharashka koorsada waxayna bixisaa taageero dhaqaale.
entity6.id6.title: Tababarka warshadaha gaarka ah
entity6.id6.subtitle: Wadooyin gaar ah oo loo maro xirfadaha la raadiyo
entity6.id6.entry1.title: Xirfadaha kalkaalinta iyo caafimaadka
entity6.id6.entry1.subtitle: Tababarka kaaliyaha kalkaalisada (2 sano) ama caafimaad iyo kalkaalisnimo u qalma (3 sano, shahaadada FH).Dugsiyada: Dugsiyada caafimaadka iyo kalkaalinta ee isbitaallada, kulliyadaha farsamada.Baahi weyn oo loo qabo shaqaale xirfad leh!
entity6.id6.entry2.title: IT & digitalization
entity6.id6.entry2.subtitle: Wadooyinka Tababarka: Tababarka (horumarinta abka, tignoolajiyada macluumaadka), HTL (Kulliyada Farsamada Sare), daraasaadka FH ama koorsooyinka shahaado (tusaale WIFI loogu talagalay codeing, technology network, cybersecurity).
entity6.id6.entry3.title: Dhismaha iyo xirfado xirfadeed
entity6.id6.entry3.subtitle: Dariiqa qadiimiga ah waa shaqo-barasho (bulidayste, nijaar, tuubiste).Horumarka loo marayo imtixaanka masterka (diyaarinta WIFI).HTL ee tignoolajiyada dhismaha ama kulliyadda maamulka dhismaha ayaa sidoo kale suurtagal ah.
entity6.id6.entry4.title: Gastronomy & Dalxiiska
entity6.id6.entry4.subtitle: Tababar (cunto karin, khabiir makhaayad), dugsiga maaraynta huteelada (dugsiga dhexe), dugsiyada dalxiiska (dugsiga sare) ama koorsooyinka kulliyadda farsamada.Koorasyada tababbarka gaaban ee baristas ama sommeliers sidoo kale waa caan.
entity6.id7.title: Maalgelinta iyo deeqaha
entity6.id7.subtitle: Taageero leh kharash
entity6.id7.entry1.title: Maalgelinta AMS
entity6.id7.entry1.subtitle: AMS waxay dabooli kartaa 100% kharashka koorsada haddii tababarka dheeraadka ah uu kordhiyo fursadaha shaqo.Inta lagu jiro koorsooyinka waqti-buuxa ah ee dheer, waxay bixiyaan gunnada taageerada (oo la mid ah lacagta shaqo la'aanta).
entity6.id7.entry2.title: Fasaxa waxbarashada iyo shaqo waxbarasho oo waqti-dhiman ah
entity6.id7.entry2.subtitle: Fasaxa waxbarashada: Ilaa 1 sano oo fasax shaqo ah oo mushahar ah oo tababar dheeraad ah.Shaqo-waxbarasho oo waqti-dhiman ah: Dhimista saacadaha shaqada ilaa 25-75% ilaa 4 sano oo leh tababar isku mar ah.Labada xaaladoodba waxaad ka heli doontaa lacag tababar dheeraad ah AMS.
entity6.id7.entry3.title: Maalgelinta dawladaha iyo aasaaska
entity6.id7.entry3.subtitle: Dawladaha federaalku waxay leeyihiin lacag u gaar ah (tusaale, WAFF gudaha Vienna, SFG gudaha Styria).Aasaaska sida Rugta Shaqaalaha (AK) ee Taageerada Waxbarashada ama Sanduuqa Taageerada Kartida leh waxay bixiyaan taageero kharash.
entity6.id7.entry4.title: Canshuur dhimis
entity6.id7.entry4.subtitle: Kharashaadka tababarka iyo waxbarashada dheeraadka ah ee la xidhiidha shaqadaada waxa lagu sheegan karaa kharashaadka ganacsiga ee qiimaynta shaqaalaha ( magdhawga cashuurta mushaharka).Taasi waxay badbaadisaa cashuuraha.
entity6.id8.title: Duubista kartida & aqoonsiga
entity6.id8.subtitle: Ka faa'iidayso aqoontaadii hore
entity6.id8.entry1.title: Isku dheelitirnaanta kartida & falanqaynta suurtagalka ah
entity6.id8.entry1.subtitle: AMS ama BIZ (xarumaha macluumaadka farsamada) waxay bixiyaan falanqayn suurtagal ah oo bilaash ah.Awoodaha, xiisaha iyo dariiqyada shaqada ee suurtogalka ah ayaa lagu aqoonsaday doodaha iyo imtixaannada.Tani waxay kaa caawinaysaa inaad doorato tababarka saxda ah.
entity6.id8.entry2.title: Xaqiijinta xirfadaha aan rasmiga ahayn ee la helay
entity6.id8.entry2.subtitle: Khibrad shaqo laakiin shahaado la'aan?Waxaa lagu tijaabin karaa xirfadahaaga oo lagu cadeeyn karaa habka ansixinta (tusaale ahaan BFI ama abif).Tani waxay u horseedi kartaa dhamaystirka tababarka qayb ahaan ama dhamaystiran.
entity6.id8.entry3.title: Aqoonta tababarka
entity6.id8.entry3.subtitle: Aqoontii hore ee tababarkii hore ama dibadda ayaa inta badan lagu xisaabin karaa koorsada tababarka cusub.Tani waxay soo gaabinaysaa muddada tababarka.La hadal machadka tababarka ama xafiiska shaqo-barasho ee WKO.
entity6.id8.entry4.title: Talo waxbarasho Austria
entity6.id8.entry4.subtitle: Shabakadda La-talinta Waxbarashada Austria waxay bixisaa talo bilaash ah, dhexdhexaad ah oo qarsoodi ah dhammaan waddooyinka waxbarashada.Taleefanka, khadka tooska ah ama shakhsi ahaan mid ka mid ah xarumaha badan ee la talinta ee dhammaan gobolada federaalka.
